text:
Actum in Fundo Hollandorum Trąmpczynensium domoque ingenui Martini Hunt feria quinta post Festum Sanctae Catharinae Virginis et Martyris proxima die scilicet vigesima octava mensis Novembris anno Domini millesimo septingentesimo octuagesimo secundo.
Praesentibus Generosis Michaële Brzeżański Leone Maszewski et aliis nec non provido Bartholomaeo Szepczyński de villa Trąmpczyn ministeriali regni generali actum praesentem acclamante.
Officium commissoriale palatinatus majoris Poloniae insistendo decreto in judiciis ordinariis generalibus tribunalis regni Petricoviae feria quinta post Festum Sanctae Hedvigis viduae electae proxima die scilicet decimaseptima mensis Octobris anno praesenti inter Illustrissimum Magnificum Antonium Prusimski Capitaneum Nieszczeviensis Ordinis Sancti Stanislai Equitem actorem, et citatum tum Magnificum Stanislaum Chełmski Thesaurarium Vschoviensis citatum et actorem ac alios comparitione ejusdem decreti expressos prolato quo mediante post decisam per idem judicium tribunalium cathegoriam granicialem in seorsiva cathegoria deoccupationis Hollandi quia patuit ex actibus officiorum campestrium Ingenuum Martinum Hunt Hollandum nullomodo à parte dextra lineae per judicii tribunalium determinatae extare et ad Magnificum Chełmski spectare posse, jam verò Magnificum Chełmski eundem Hollandum ad usque possedisse proinde minime obstante actu deoccupatorio per officium castrense Gnesniensis notariatus expedito statutum est quatinus Magnificus Chełmski eundem ingenuum Martinum Hunt Hollandum in possessionem Illustrissimi Magnifici Prusimski in sex ab actu ejusdem decreti septimanis praesenti commissario palatinatus majoris Poloniae per Illustrissimum Magnificum Prusimski conducendo redderet et restitueret quin potius idem Generosus Commissarius eundem Hollandum Illustrissimo Magnifico Prusimski in actualem possessionem praeciso calculo traderet et dimitteret decreto eodem seu cathegoria praemissa fusius enarrante in locum actu descriptum die hodierna ad requisitionem Illustrissimi Magnifici Antonii in Kolno Prusimski Capitanei Nieszczeviensis insignis Sancti Stanislai Equitis condescendit ibidemque fundata sua jurisdictione et per ministerialem acclamata ingenuum Martinum Hunt Hollandum in actualem possessionem praedicti Illustrissimi Magnifici Prusimski circa actum hunc personaliter praesentis tradidit et dimisit atque in pacifica possessione nemine impugnante indicta suprascripto Ingenuo Martino Hunt pro re Illustrissimi Magnifici Prusimski Capitanei Nieszczeviensis obedientia eundem reliquit prout relinquit actus praesentis vigore Josephus Łukaszewicz Palatinatus Majoris Poloniae Generalis Commissarius mp

translation.en:
[Section 6 — Condescensorial Decree: Possession of the Olęder Martin Hunt]

Done at the estate of the Trąbczyn olędry and at the house of the Freeborn Martin Hunt, on Thursday after the Feast of Saint Catherine, Virgin and Martyr, namely the 28th of November in the year of the Lord 1782.

Present: the Honourable Michał Brzeżański, Leon Maszewski, and others; and also the Honest Bartłomiej Szepczyński of the village of Trąbczyn, general Court Summoner of the realm, proclaiming the present act.

The commissarial office of the Greater Poland Voivodeship, insisting upon the decree issued in the ordinary general sessions of the Crown Tribunal of Piotrków, on Thursday after the Feast of Saint Hedwig, Widow and Elect, namely the 17th of October of the present year, between the Most Honourable Antoni Prusimski, Starost of Niszczewice, Knight of the Order of Saint Stanisław, plaintiff and defendant, and also the Right Honourable Stanisław Chełmski, Treasurer of Wschowa, defendant and plaintiff, and others expressed in that same decree by their appearances — by means of which decree, after the boundary category had been decided by that same Tribunal court, in the separate category of the recovery of possession of the olęder: since it was clear from the acts of the field offices that the Freeborn olęder Martin Hunt in no way stands on the right side of the line determined by the Tribunal court, and could not belong to the Right Honourable Chełmski, and that the Right Honourable Chełmski had been possessing that same olęder until now — therefore, notwithstanding the act of recovery of possession issued by the notarial office of the Gniezno Municipal Court, it was ordained that the Right Honourable Chełmski should return and restore that same Freeborn olęder Martin Hunt to the possession of the Most Honourable Prusimski within six weeks from the act of the same decree, to the present commissioner of the Greater Poland Voivodeship to be engaged by the Most Honourable Prusimski; or rather that the same Honourable Commissioner should transfer and release that same olęder to the Most Honourable Prusimski into actual possession at a calculated reckoning — the same decree or the aforesaid category setting it out more fully —

descended today to the place described in the act at the request of the Most Honourable Antoni of Kolno Prusimski, Starost of Niszczewice, Knight of the Order of Saint Stanisław; and there, having established its jurisdiction and proclaimed it through the Court Summoner, transferred and released the Freeborn olęder Martin Hunt into the actual possession of the said Most Honourable Prusimski, who was present in person at this act; and left him in peaceful possession, no one challenging, obedience to the Most Honourable Prusimski, Starost of Niszczewice, having been enjoined on the said Freeborn Martin Hunt — as it leaves him by force of the present act.

Józef Łukaszewicz, General Commissioner of the Greater Poland Voivodeship, by his own hand.

summary_en: An act of 28 November 1782, done in the Olęder settlement of Trąbczyn at the house of Martin Hunt, in the presence of Michał Brzeżański, Leon Maszewski and others; the court messenger Bartłomiej Szepczyński of Trąbczyn proclaimed the act. The commissioner's office of the palatinate of Greater Poland acts under the decree of the Crown Tribunal at Piotrków of 17 October of the same year between Antoni Prusimski, Starost of Niszczewice, and Stanisław Chełmski, Treasurer of Wschowa. By that decree the Olęder settler Martin Hunt does not sit to the right of the line the Tribunal fixed and cannot belong to Chełmski, who had held him until then; Chełmski was to give him up to Prusimski within six weeks before the commissioner. At the request of Prusimski, who is present in person, the commissioner delivers Martin Hunt into his actual possession and binds Hunt to obedience to Prusimski; no one objects. Józef Łukaszewicz, general commissioner of the palatinate of Greater Poland, signed.
summary_de: Urkunde vom 28. November 1782, aufgenommen in der Trąbczyner Olęder-Siedlung im Haus von Martin Hunt, in Gegenwart von Michał Brzeżański, Leon Maszewski und anderen; der Gerichtsbote Bartłomiej Szepczyński von Trąbczyn rief die Handlung aus. Das Kommissariatsamt der großpolnischen Woiwodschaft handelt nach dem Dekret des Krontribunals in Petrikau vom 17. Oktober desselben Jahres zwischen Antoni Prusimski, Starost von Niszczewice, und Stanisław Chełmski, Schatzmeister von Wschowa. Danach sitzt der Olęder Martin Hunt nicht rechts der vom Tribunal bestimmten Linie und kann nicht Chełmski gehören, der ihn bis dahin besaß; Chełmski sollte ihn binnen sechs Wochen vor dem Kommissar an Prusimski herausgeben. Auf Verlangen Prusimskis, der persönlich anwesend ist, übergibt der Kommissar Martin Hunt in dessen tatsächlichen Besitz und verpflichtet Hunt zum Gehorsam gegenüber Prusimski; niemand widerspricht. Józef Łukaszewicz, Generalkommissar der großpolnischen Woiwodschaft, hat unterschrieben.
